data.gender_notes: Rafiq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rafiq is an Arabic name that signifies a close friend or companion. In Islamic tradition, it represents a strong bond between individuals. The name Rafiq carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rafiq usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Quranic context, Rafiq is associated with the concept of brotherhood and unity among believers.
data.etymology: Rafiq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rafiq total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Rafiq
in_english.meaning: To accompany and be a companion to someone and to seek Allah's assistance
in_english.long_meaning: Rafiq is a person who accompanies and is a companion to others and seeks the assistance of Allah. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'R-F-Q' which means 'to accompany' or 'to be a companion to'. Rafiq is one of the names of Allah in the Quran and is often used to describe a person who is close to Allah and seeks His assistance.
